title: Exploit maturity, PoC claims, offline CVE mirror and MSRC Patch Tuesday facts (P190 exploit_index/poc_index, P352 cve_offline_mirror, P353 msrc_patch_tuesday)
notes: Facts added to the consolidated CVE card with provenance. Exploit or PoC availability raises patch priority only: it never verifies a version-inferred match or sets CRITICAL by itself (P190 cond 4, P291). 'kev' stays CISA-only: Microsoft's exploited flag goes to the core attribute 'exploited' with source 'msrc' (P353 cond 3).

attributes.exploit_maturity: maturity of public exploit code for a CVE: 'weaponised' (Metasploit module or Exploit-DB entry), 'detection template' (nuclei CVE template only) or 'poc_claimed (N repos)' (unverified GitHub PoC claims, confidence <= 0.4)
attributes.exploit_sources: counts of curated exploit references per source {exploitdb, metasploit, metasploit_exploit_modules, metasploit_scanner_modules, nuclei, kev}
attributes.exploit_index_refs: list of curated exploit/template references {source, url, label, ...} from Exploit-DB, Metasploit and nuclei (references only: never downloaded or run)
attributes.exploit_summary: plain-words exploit availability line, e.g. 'public exploit code: 2 Metasploit, 3 Exploit-DB - raises patch priority only'
attributes.poc_repos_total: int: number of distinct public GitHub repositories claiming a PoC for the CVE (PoC-in-GitHub and trickest/cve)
attributes.poc_repos: top PoC repository claims {repo (defanged), stars, pushed_at, source, label}: unverified code, may be malicious - never run outside an isolated lab
attributes.poc_references: untrusted reference links listed by trickest/cve for the CVE (advisories, write-ups, PoC pages); links only, never fetched
attributes.poc_confidence: confidence (<= 0.4) of the PoC claims: GitHub repositories claiming a PoC are not verified exploit code
attributes.poc_summary: plain-words PoC claim line with the safety label
attributes.cve_mirror: provenance of an answer from the local CVE mirror {synced_at, age_hours, stale, records, record_updated, record_sha256}
attributes.msrc_title: title of the vulnerability in the MSRC Patch Tuesday (CVRF) document
attributes.msrc_severity: highest Microsoft severity rating of the CVE across its products (Critical, Important, Moderate, Low)
attributes.msrc_impact: Microsoft impact class of the CVE (e.g. Remote Code Execution, Elevation of Privilege)
attributes.msrc_exploited: bool: Microsoft reports exploitation of the CVE (CVRF exploit status 'Exploited:Yes'); never the CISA KEV flag
attributes.msrc_publicly_disclosed: bool: Microsoft reports the CVE as publicly disclosed before the fix
attributes.msrc_exploitability: Microsoft exploitability assessment {latest_release, older_release} (e.g. 'Exploitation More Likely')
attributes.msrc_priority_line: plain-words Microsoft priority line, e.g. 'Exploited per Microsoft (not in CISA KEV yet): patch now'
attributes.msrc_remediation: list of Microsoft vendor fixes {kb, url, sub_type, fixed_build, fixed_build_url, supersedes, restart_required, products}
attributes.msrc_kbs: list of Microsoft KB numbers that fix the CVE
attributes.msrc_documents: list of MSRC Patch Tuesday document ids (e.g. '2026-Nov') listing the CVE
attributes.msrc_kb_cves: list of CVE ids fixed by a Microsoft KB (keyword lookup in the local MSRC index)
attributes.msrc_search_hits: list of {cve, severity, exploited, title} of the local MSRC index whose affected Microsoft products match a keyword (newest first)

relations.exploit_reference: CVE -> curated exploit or detection-template reference URL (Exploit-DB, Metasploit, nuclei); reference only
relations.poc_claim: CVE -> public repository URL claiming a PoC (unverified code, may be malicious; never expanded or run)
relations.fixes: update/KB keyword -> CVE it fixes (vendor remediation)
relations.affected_by: product keyword -> CVE affecting that product
